title: Amazon.nl: 14-day statutory withdrawal for unused item
facts_text: I received a smart watch from Amazon.nl 7 days ago. It is unused, complete, and not defective. I wish to cancel the purchase under the 14-day statutory withdrawal right and return the item. The original delivery charge was EUR 5.99, and I understand I may need to pay the return-shipping cost of EUR 10.50.
request: Please process my statutory withdrawal and refund EUR 179.00 to my original payment method, with the return cost borne by me.

strict.reason: The withdrawal right is available within 14 days for a non-excluded item. Full refund is required; return-shipping costs are the customer's responsibility unless otherwise stated.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: The statutory withdrawal right applies within 14 days and the item is eligible. The return shipping charge may be the customer's responsibility.
exception.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

ambiguous.reason: The statutory right is clear; discretion mainly concerns the treatment of the delivery cost and return-shipping allocation.
ambiguous.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

review_notes: This scenario tests the distinction between voluntary returns and statutory withdrawal rights. The return is within the 14-day legal cancellation window.
